tutorial.cpuCards: You can see your opponents' cards. Use this information to decide your action.
tutorial.playerCard: Your card is hidden from you. It will be revealed at showdown.
tutorial.actionButtons: Choose an action: Bet, Call, Raise, or Fold. Make your decision based on opponents' cards.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

hint.opponentsStrong: Opponents show strong cards — your card may be weak
hint.opponentsWeak: Opponents show weak cards — your card may be strong
